children: abrdn Global Infrastructure Income Fund approved a transferable rights offering to let existing shareholders subscribe for new shares at a discount.
Board approved issuance of transferable rights to common shareholders to subscribe for new Common Shares.
Record Date is September 21, 2026; one Right per Common Share; three Rights to subscribe for one new share.
Subscription period expected from Sept 21, 2026 to Oct 15, 2026; Rights to trade as ASGI RTWI (when-issued) and ASGI RT.
Subscription price = 92.5% of avg. closing market price over five days ending on Expiration Date or 92.5% of NAV if lower.
Proceeds to increase investable assets across global infrastructure; shareholders bear offering expenses; new shares not eligible for certain upcoming distributions.
